title: t1: Link Community Apps Package button to the package repository (requires Cloudron 10)
body:
## What

Link the Cloudron Community Apps "Package" button to this package repository (https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app) instead of the maintainer profile. The listing falls back to `packagerUrl` when `packageUrl` is absent.

Maintainer decision (2026-11-01): drop Cloudron 9.x support. Cloudron 9.x rejects unknown manifest fields when parsing `CloudronVersions.json`, so one `packageUrl` in any catalog entry stops 9.x servers resolving the whole catalog; `minBoxVersion` gating does not prevent that (marcusquinn/aidevops-cloudron-app#66, marcusquinn/cloudron-netbird-app#62). Guidance: marcusquinn/aidevops#36416.

### Files Scope

- `CloudronManifest.json`
- `CHANGELOG`
- `README.md`

## How

- Add `"packageUrl": "https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app"` next to `packagerUrl`; keep `packagerUrl` as the maintainer profile.
- Set `minBoxVersion` to `10.0.0`.
- Bump the package patch version with an unchanged upstream version; changelog entry states the repository link and that Cloudron 10.0.0 or later is now required.
- Invert package-test assertions that reject `packageUrl` or pin `minBoxVersion` 9.1.0; keep historical catalog entries unchanged.
- Update documented Cloudron requirements to 10.0.0.

## Verification

- `test/package-test.sh` (where present)
- `cloudron-package-helper.sh validate`, `check-compatibility`, `preflight-release vX.Y.Z`
- PR `catalog / preflight` (CLI dry run and no-push image build)

## Acceptance

- New manifest has `packageUrl` = repository URL, `packagerUrl` unchanged, `minBoxVersion` 10.0.0, bumped version.
- No existing `CloudronVersions.json` entry is modified.
- Release goes through the signed release-approval gate; after publication the Community Apps Package link opens the repository.

<!-- aidevops:origin:interactive -->
<!-- aidevops:sig -->
---

title: t2: Point Community Apps Package link at the repository via packagerUrl
body:
## Task


Make the Community Apps **Package** link open this repository (https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app).

ca.cloudron.io builds both the "By Marcus Quinn" link and the "Package" link from `packagerUrl` only; it ignores `packageUrl` (marcusquinn/aidevops#36428). The previous release added `packageUrl`, but the listing still links to the maintainer profile.

```json

```

PR number: 22; exact head: `9f254adb7564b1493bbef04a00b1fd0dacf313db`. Package: 0.1.7; upstream: 0.7.2.

### Changelog
* Update Warmbly to 0.7.2 at upstream commit 7af95ad, with release image digests pinned from upstream's images.json.
* Lead finder: search a map for businesses (OpenStreetMap by default, no key needed), enrich them with website emails and add them to contacts (upstream 0.7.0).
* Per-campaign ramp-up, sending in each lead's local time, region segments, warmup recipients balanced by provider, and shared notifications sent as one digest (upstream 0.7.2).
* Typed mailbox send pauses, better bounce accuracy, opt-in per-step inbox rotation and client roles for restricted members (upstream 0.7.0).
* Gmail mailboxes connected with your own Google OAuth client now ask for full mail access (https://mail.google.com/) so warmup can run over IMAP; add that scope to the client's consent screen. The dashboard offers Google sign-in whenever the backend allows it (upstream 0.7.0).
* IMAP folder cursors work with NetEase servers (upstream 0.7.1).
* Retain the Cloudron first-owner sign-in patch and the pinned Cloudron 6.0.1 base.

### Verification

title: Supervisor health dashboard missing last_refresh marker (#26)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard body at #26 does not contain a `last_refresh: <ISO8601>` marker. Either the dashboard has never been rebuilt by the current version of `stats-health-dashboard.sh`, or the marker has been stripped from the body.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status.

   macOS / launchd:

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

   Linux / systemd user timers:

   ```bash
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer --no-pager
   systemctl --user status aidevops-stats-wrapper.service --no-pager
   systemctl --user list-timers --all --no-pager 'aidevops*'
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/.config/systemd/user/aidevops-stats-wrapper.*
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app/issues/26 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **macOS missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **Linux missing or inactive systemd timer:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so the Linux scheduler setup reinstalls and enables `aidevops-stats-wrapper.timer` and `aidevops-stats-wrapper.service` under `~/.config/systemd/user`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 26 --repo marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.

title: t3: Restore packagerUrl to the maintainer profile now that ca.cloudron.io reads packageUrl
body:
## Task


Point `packagerUrl` in `CloudronManifest.json` back at the maintainer profile `https://github.com/marcusquinn`, keep `packageUrl` as `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app`, and update any check that pins the current manifest's `packagerUrl` to the repository URL. Do not cut a release: the change ships with this package's next upstream-update release.

## Done when

- [ ] `CloudronManifest.json` has `packagerUrl` `https://github.com/marcusquinn` and `packageUrl` `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app`.
- [ ] Existing package checks and required PR checks pass.
- [ ] Regression guard: `CloudronVersions.json`, the manifest `version` and released changelog entries are unchanged, and no `v*` tag is pushed.
- [ ] After the next published upstream-update release (outside this task), the listing's "By" link opens the profile and Package opens this repository.

<details>
<summary>Worker implementation contract</summary>

## Worker Guidance


### Files to Modify

- `EDIT: CloudronManifest.json` — the `packagerUrl` value.

### Complete Write Surface

- **Callers/readers:** ca.cloudron.io and Cloudron dashboards read `packagerUrl` from the published `CloudronVersions.json` entry, which the catalog workflow copies from `CloudronManifest.json` only when a new version is published.
- **Writers/mutation paths:** `CloudronManifest.json` only. `CloudronVersions.json` is written by `.github/workflows/cloudron-catalog-publish.yml` on a new version; not touched here.
- **Existing verification/tests:** none pin `packagerUrl` (no `test/` directory at filing; the repo's only script is `scripts/render-store-media.sh`). Verify with the `jq` command below and the catalog workflow's PR run.
- **Schemas/config:** Cloudron manifest field `packagerUrl` (URL). No schema change.
- **Generated/deployed mirrors:** published catalog entries are frozen per version; the new value appears from the next published version. No other generated copy (`rg -n packagerUrl --glob '!CloudronVersions.json' --glob '!CHANGELOG*'` at filing found only the files listed).
- **Migrations/backfills:** N/A because published `CloudronVersions.json` entries are immutable by policy, so older versions are not backfilled.
- **Cleanup/rollback paths:** revert the `CloudronManifest.json` change; no published state changes until the next release.

### Implementation Steps

1. In `CloudronManifest.json`, replace:

   ```json
   "packagerUrl": "https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app",
   ```

   with:

   ```json
   "packagerUrl": "https://github.com/marcusquinn",
   ```

   Leave `packageUrl` as `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app` and `minBoxVersion` as `10.0.0`.
2. No package test pins `packagerUrl` at filing; skip unless step 3 finds one.

3. Run `rg -n 'packagerUrl' --glob '!CloudronVersions.json' --glob '!CHANGELOG*'` and update any other check on the current manifest that still expects the repository URL. Leave assertions about historical catalog entries unchanged.

### Hazards and Compatibility

- **Concurrency/atomicity:** N/A — single metadata value in one PR; the catalog workflow serializes publication with its concurrency group.
- **Migration/rollback:** no catalog change; revert the PR to roll back before the next release.
- **Mixed-version/backward compatibility:** already-published entries keep the repository URL; only the next published entry changes. `packageUrl` stays, so Cloudron 10 requirement and listing Package link are unchanged.
- **Idempotency/retry:** re-applying the edit is a no-op once the value is the profile URL.
- **Partial failure/recovery:** if checks fail, fix the assertion in the same PR; nothing is published.
- Do not change `version`, `CloudronVersions.json` or released `CHANGELOG`/`CHANGELOG.md` entries. Do not push a `v*` tag. With the version unchanged, the catalog workflow on `main` reconciles only and does not publish.

### Verification Before Dispatch

```bash
jq -e '.packagerUrl == "https://github.com/marcusquinn" and .packageUrl == "https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app" and .minBoxVersion == "10.0.0"' CloudronManifest.json
git diff --exit-code origin/main -- CloudronVersions.json CHANGELOG
```

- **Surface mapping:** the `jq` check proves the manifest values; the `git diff` proves the catalog and released changelog are untouched.
- **Broad verification trigger:** Not required.

### Scope Boundaries

**Hard boundaries:** no release, tag, version bump, `CloudronVersions.json` edit, or edits to released changelog entries.

**AI brief owner:** the maintainer's interactive session that filed this issue.

### Files Scope

- `CloudronManifest.json`

</details>

<details>
<summary>Full task brief and audit context</summary>

## Task Brief

<!-- aidevops:brief-schema=v2 -->

## Origin

- **Created:** 2026-11-11
- **Created by:** ai-interactive (requested by the maintainer)
- **Parent task:** none. Framework guidance fix: marcusquinn/aidevops#37825 (PR marcusquinn/aidevops#37826)
- **Blocked by:** none
- **Conversation context:** Cloudron changed ca.cloudron.io on 2026-11-11 after our forum request (Cloudron forum topic 16235, post 132750). The listing's Package link now uses `packageUrl`, falling back to `packagerUrl`; the "By" link still uses `packagerUrl`. The earlier workaround of setting `packagerUrl` to the repository is no longer needed.

## What

Point `packagerUrl` in `CloudronManifest.json` back at the maintainer profile `https://github.com/marcusquinn`, keep `packageUrl` as `https://github.com/marcusquinn/cloudron-warmbly-app`, and update any check that pins the current manifest's `packagerUrl` to the repository URL. Do not cut a release: the change ships with this package's next upstream-update release.

## Why

The Community Apps listing shows "By Marcus Quinn" linked to this repository instead of the maintainer profile. The live ca.cloudron.io bundle now builds the Package link from `manifest.packageUrl || manifest.packagerUrl`, so the Package link keeps opening this repository after the change, and "By" opens the profile again.

## Tier

**Selected tier:** `tier:simple`

**Tier rationale:** one manifest value, with exact old and new strings and an existing check as verification. No release, catalog, workflow or changelog changes.

## Context & Decisions

- Guidance: `~/.aidevops/agents/tools/deployment/cloudron-app-publishing-skill.md` (`packageUrl` paragraph, updated in marcusquinn/aidevops#37826).
- Maintainer decision (2026-11-11): file now and let it ship with the next upstream-update release, not a dedicated release.
